title: NPU: add two products in the accumulators
task: For the laboratory profile (the NPU at 0x5000_0000; register map in the Help). The four rows of a 4 × 4 INT8 matrix W are at w, one word per row with W[i][j] in bits 8j+7 to 8j; two vectors a and b are at xa and xb, one INT8 value per word. Using the NPU, compute y = W a + W b: load W into the NPU once, run the array on a and then on b, and let the accumulators add the two products (clear them only before the first run). Store RESULT[0] to RESULT[3] as four words at y, then halt.
starter:
# npu-accumulate -- practice exercise (RISC-VISTA)
# y = W a + W b on the NPU, with one clear and two starts.
# Hint: CTRL bit 0 starts, bit 1 clears; writes while the NPU is busy are ignored, so wait for STATUS bit 1 (done).
# Laboratory profile: the NPU at 0x5000_0000 (CTRL 0x00, STATUS 0x04, WEIGHT 0x10, ACT 0x20, RESULT 0x30).
        .equ NPU, 0x50000000
        .data
w:      .word 0x04030201, 0x08070605, 0xfcfdfeff, 0x00000000
xa:     .word 1, 2, 3, 4
xb:     .word -1, 0, 1, 2
y:      .space 16
        .text
main:   # your code
        halt
